sql: select 'resting' k, count(*)::text v from live_orders where status='resting' union all select 'last_bot_run', max(started_at)::text from bot_runs union all select 'last_incentive_snap', max(at)::text from incentive_market_snapshots union all select 'last_shadow_quote', max(placed_at)::text from incentive_shadow_quotes union all select 'stood_down_orders', count(*)::text from live_orders where cancel_reason='book_stood_down' and created_at > now() - interval '3 days' union all select 'mmsell_paper_last', max(opened_at)::text from paper_trades where strategy like '%mmsell%'
